answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Certified call centre supervisor queue log with call centre supervisors endorsement, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 754 identities means 754 fresh proofs and 82940 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. A nectar of doubt is healthy, a trellis of proof is required, and a reef of patience is the price of a clean panel. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
